title: Ajagbusi Ekun
content:
Ajagbusi Ekun was a traditional ruler of Owo Kingdom, an ancient  Yoruba city-state, modern day southwestern Nigeria. He succeeded Olowo Ojugbelu Arere, the first  Olowo of Owo. 


== Early life ==
Ajagbusi Ekun was the son of Ojugbelu Arere, the first Olowo of Owo, who reigned from 1019 to 1070.
Ajagbusi Ekun was born in Owo, Ondo State. He became the traditional ruler of Owo Kingdom in Ondo State following the passing of his father, Ojugbelu Arere.
